text:
## Toolbox » Menu Manager
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000034716

## Where Can I Access This Tool?
Inside Toolbox » Menu Manager:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124075562/original/nQaepMMpbnaDVvUwBo6bSbymaunlTPVRLg.png?1681491698 | alt: ]

## What are the Default Menu Options?
By default, the Menu Manager comes with 5 different menu options.

## Header Main Menu
Accessible via /home and most of the website.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124075687/original/CIVR4W8Ou7gX7mbieCgl6Md9GUKoaceHpA.png?1681491784 | alt: ]

## Side-by-Side Pricing Menu - add-on
Can be added to the /join page.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124075871/original/R8q7NkB1AaXWosmyCCcWQ498s1oEh0Tv6A.png?1681491967 | alt: ]

## Footer Menu
Is accessible on any page by the default
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076002/original/AtRK7-QYJCJDrkGq3s8cyjmkU1aSFw5Vxg.png?1681492143 | alt: ]

## Header Mini Nav
Is accessible via /home
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076020/original/HTNI3rJX0Gxu1aUg_g5Q-eMR7unGeoPa2g.png?1681492207 | alt: ]

## Login Page Links
Is accessible via /login
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12161699960/original/Z6C8n0aPNJpY2GZAfnqNAMoCa1SVxQunZQ.png?1747890971 | alt: ]

## How Can I Edit These Menus?
Click Customize under Actions to edit a menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076121/original/VG7DzbbQ41Y88yEsi9S6fR0xf3m8Lfs5MQ.png?1681492323 | alt: ]
In this instance, let's make changes to the " Main Menu ".
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076208/original/4LgvUEXfXzFhIGNZc0m89vtkN4QGpDcyUg.png?1681492434 | alt: ]
Add an additional link by clicking on the " New Link+ " button:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076232/original/8khdt6EXT2lujF__mA3HDOwb67BGHb23Ow.png?1681492486 | alt: ]
Once the text and URL are added, click Save Changes . Once saved, the edited menu will start appearing above the Default Menus, indicating it is a Custom Menu.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076327/original/nYoOxbtIhzmAdpNqrgKtf1R_Ai1rUv1PAQ.png?1681492605 | alt: ]
When clicked on " Edit " on Custom Menus:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076345/original/YFPQgLaWa5TfJfVO_RtrlHZ70mzJyAtm4g.png?1681492631 | alt: ]
There is a button option called  " Edit Menu Settings ":
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076392/original/09Ry8Nn6ueAQrVq3gPhzTaFtXnaWxJVRsg.png?1681492678 | alt: ]
Once clicked, a module will display where the Nickname and System Name can be assigned for the menu:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076498/original/PnFNipucR2Iv6BUkLnqLMtMs-7287TXYpA.png?1681492740 | alt: ]
Additionally, Custom Menus will have a few options under Actions :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076542/original/EJ1__d5DtGMAKqmsI5erQvmc8lZ1y_HzHw.png?1681492780 | alt: ]
- Clicking Disable will disable the custom menu and its default version will be used on the website. This is very helpful for troubleshooting purposes:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076575/original/1yGnC3RodWxVNckvtnC4ECCqxyBnn7wnRw.png?1681492825 | alt: ]
- Clicking Clone will clone this custom menu and will assign a custom Menu Name and Shortcode :
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124076620/original/0e1yW1SLc0ntMFPpNICPYULzPl9Oyh908g.png?1681492867 | alt: ]
- Clicking Copy Shortcode will copy the shortcode of this custom menu, with this copied shortcode, it is easy to call the menu on the preferred location like in a webpage or a widget ( How To Call A Menu On A Webpage ).
Ex) [menu=main_menu_clone_33]
- Click Delete to remove this custom menu.

## How to Create Dropdown Menus
Drag a menu item beneath another to create a child element.
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124077589/original/4SJwzRkidf3u65XpZhNvaaeU8vL9-I3VPQ.png?1681493881 | alt: ]
After saving:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124077626/original/yBt0ejDjZbKKrsiFRsrcTOYD55I_1Kldvw.png?1681493956 | alt: ]
Click to hide:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124077606/original/EPcUaUXevLK-HYDbE5Si7aOKolTnhQoHfA.png?1681493936 | alt: ]
The drop-down menu shows up on the front end:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124077646/original/l0gHXTcceCG4TQre-j4CiOlb29yikkpV-A.png?1681493989 | alt: ]

## More Editing Options For Menu Links
All menu links come with a " Settings " button that allows for further changes:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124077727/original/cZdUPTAKbzw0ik6OSkOjgtns2ej0OfHD9A.png?1681494026 | alt: ]
Link / Text Link CSS Class - In this section, add preferred CSS Class to the <a> element. This is an ideal place to use pre-maid Bootstrap classes if needed.
<li> CSS Class - In this section, add preferred CSS Class to the <li> element. This is an ideal place to use pre-maid Bootstrap classes if needed.
Link / Text Inline Style Attribute - In this section, add preferred style elements to the <a> element.
<li> Inline Style Attribute - In this section, add preferred style elements to the <li> element.
Add no-follow - This setting will indicate if search engines should follow this link or not.
Open in a new window - This setting will indicate if the link should open in a new tab or not.
Hide Item - This setting will hide the menu item in the front end but will still be available in the menu manager.
Additional Information:
>> How To Edit The Options For Menu Links
